_note: Everyday habits that help each result, besides food (CONTEXT.md: Habit). Rules pick them from the Donor's results; the AI may only word them. habit: movement | food | mind. measuredBy: the app signal that shows whether it is kept, when there is one. PROPOSED, pending clinical review.

habits.text: Something sour with your iron-rich meal (lemon, amla, guava or tomato)
Tea and coffee an hour away from meals
Cook dal or sabzi in an iron kadai
A 15–20 minute walk in mid-morning sun, arms uncovered
Curd, milk or paneer once a day

habits.source: WHO 2020; ACC/AHA 2017: 150 minutes a week lowers BP by 5–7 mmHg

habits.text: A 10-minute walk after your biggest meal
No pickle, papad or namkeen on most days; less salt in cooking
habits.source: ICMR / ACC-AHA 2017: sodium under 2,300 mg a day

habits.text: Half the plate dal and vegetables first, then rice or roti
Measure cooking oil (about 4 teaspoons a day); fried snacks once a week
7 hours' sleep with the same wake-up time
habits.source: AASM / CDC: short sleep raises BP and blood sugar

habits.text: No alcohol, and fewer fried and sugary foods
habits.source: General medical advice for a raised liver enzyme
